records.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit input image 2 (flagstick left in the hole) to match the restrained illustration style of input image 1 (style reference only, do not add its golfer). 1536x1024 landscape. Preserve the scene: ONE golf ball on the putting green in foreground left, ONE slender upright flagstick in a realistically small golf hole farther away right. Remove all distant trees, bushes, horizon scenery, dense grass stippling, textures, gradients and shadows. Pure white background and ample margins. Show a single irregular oval putting green with an extremely pale flat mint wash and a thin muted outline so the green is identifiable; only 3 tiny grass tufts OUTSIDE its edge. Thin uniform dark teal contours, tiny pale mint triangular flag, small plain white ball without dimple texture. No people, text, arrows or new objects. The flagstick remains in the cup; the ball is stationary clearly apart from the cup. Do not crop.

Use case: style-transfer.
